Summary: Enforce mandatory initial admin password change
Problem Statement: Default admin password ('admin') initialized in SQLite DB for QUANT_OPERATOR.
Proposed Solution: Prompt for forced credential change on first CLI/GUI launch and accept secret via env var TRADINGOS_ADMIN_PASS.
Risk Mitigation: Fallback to default account lock if credentials are not updated on production environment launch.
Success Metric: Zero default passwords active in production database instance.
Rollback Strategy: Revert to baseline setup script with warning prompt.

Summary: Externalize MT5 Terminal installation path to config/env
Problem Statement: Hardcoded MT5 installation path default 'C:\Program Files\Alpari MT5\terminal64.exe' in config.py.
Proposed Solution: Load MT5 path from environment variable TRADINGOS_MT5_PATH with fallback to config default.
Risk Mitigation: Provide path validation check during startup to alert operator of missing terminal executable.
Success Metric: Successful terminal launch across custom installation directories.
Rollback Strategy: Restore static string default in config.py.

Summary: Add dynamic port selection configuration overrides
Problem Statement: Port allocations (50001-50005) hardcoded across WebAPI and IPC socket bridges.
Proposed Solution: Expose environment variables TRADINGOS_WEB_PORT and TRADINGOS_IPC_PORT to override defaults.
Risk Mitigation: Preserve existing 5-tier port fallback mechanism (50051-55555) if overridden port is unavailable.
Success Metric: Zero socket binding failure errors on host OS restarts.
Rollback Strategy: Fall back to default tier 1 port matrix.

Summary: Optimize L2/L5 Orderbook Depth Slicing Performance
Problem Statement: High-frequency orderbook impact calculation creates minor CPU spikes during peak market ticks.
Proposed Solution: Refactor L2 depth aggregation using vectorized numpy arrays inside Rust core matching engine.
Risk Mitigation: Run parallel benchmark tests against historical L5 tick snapshots to verify sub-millisecond throughput.
Success Metric: Orderbook depth processing latency under 0.5ms per tick.
Rollback Strategy: Revert to standard Python L2 depth buffer implementation.

Summary: Implement Options Chain Delta Neutral Auto-Hedger
Problem Statement: Delta exposure risk during volatile market regimes requires automated re-balancing.
Proposed Solution: Integrate Black-76 options greeks auto-hedging trigger in OptionsGreeksHedgeEngine (9100102).
Risk Mitigation: Enforce 3.0% maximum daily drawdown ceiling and INV-001 risk checks before placing hedging legs.
Success Metric: Net portfolio delta maintained within +/- 0.10 threshold.
Rollback Strategy: Disable auto-hedging toggle in dashboard settings sheet.

Summary: Enhance Control Center Dashboard real-time latency gauge
Problem Statement: Latency metric display in dashboard HTML updates at 1s intervals instead of real-time WebSocket tick rate.
Proposed Solution: Stream RTT ping telemetry directly over WebSocket port 50005 into JS dashboard panel.
Risk Mitigation: Throttle WebSocket message rate to max 20Hz to prevent browser rendering lag.
Success Metric: Smooth 60fps telemetry rendering with real-time ping gauge.
Rollback Strategy: Fall back to 1000ms polling REST endpoint.
